android.desc:
VX Player is a powerful, free HD video player for Android — play ANY video format smoothly, including MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, FLV, WMV, WebM, and stunning 4K Ultra HD files. Designed for speed, simplicity, and a premium viewing experience on every Android phone and tablet.

🎬 ALL FORMAT VIDEO PLAYER
VX Player supports every popular video format: MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, FLV, WMV, 3GP, WebM, H.265/HEVC, H.264, and many more. No conversion, no hassle — just tap any video file and it plays instantly. The ultimate all-format media player for Android.

📺 CAST TO TV (Chromecast)
Stream your local videos wirelessly to your TV, Chromecast, or any Google Cast-enabled device in seconds. Enjoy your movie collection on the big screen with zero setup.

🎧 BACKGROUND VIDEO PLAYER
Keep listening to audio from any video even when your screen turns off or you switch to another app. Perfect for music videos, podcasts, audiobooks, and online lectures. Full playback controls in the notification bar and lock screen.

📱 FLOATING POPUP VIDEO PLAYER (Picture-in-Picture)
Watch any video in a resizable floating popup window while browsing, texting, or using other apps. Auto PiP mode activates automatically when you leave the player — so you never lose your place.

👌 GESTURE VIDEO PLAYER CONTROLS
Intuitive swipe gestures let you control brightness (left side), volume (right side), and seek position (horizontal swipe) without touching any button. Pinch to zoom for a closer look. No learning curve — just swipe and play.

📁 VIDEO FILE MANAGER
VX Player automatically scans your phone and SD card for all video files. Browse by folder or list view, sort by name, date, size, or duration. Rename or delete files directly from the app. Create custom playlists and save your favourite videos to your personal Favorites collection.

🎵 EQUALIZER & BASS BOOST
Take full control of your audio with the built-in equalizer. Choose from multiple presets or manually adjust each frequency band. Bass boost delivers deeper, richer sound on any headphones or speakers.

🌐 NETWORK STREAM & URL PLAYER
Play online videos and live streams directly by entering a URL. Supports HTTP, HTTPS, RTSP, RTMP, MMS protocols and M3U/M3U8 playlist files. The perfect IPTV and online stream companion.

📸 VIDEO SCREENSHOT
Capture the perfect frame from any video with a single tap and save it directly to your gallery. Great for saving memorable moments or sharing scenes.
